title: M3: Slack
description:
Second transport. Slack app distributed by OAuth, Events API and interactivity over HTTPS only (no Socket Mode), thread_ts mapped to one Chatticus channel per thread, direct messages mapped to the member's direct channel with the bot, replies posted in-thread with the bot's name via per-message username override, signature verification, identity linking by Slack sign-in.

Exit criteria: in a development workspace a member linked to their account messages a bot, the bot answers in the thread, an unlinked Slack user is quarantined, nothing starts a turn on a bad signature.

Depends on M2.
